scripts.build: pnpm run build:api && pnpm run build:web
scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --dir apps/api exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:generate: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --dir apps/api exec prisma generate
scripts.db:seed: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --dir apps/api exec ts-node prisma/seed.ts
scripts.test:db:migrate: dotenv -e .env.test -- pnpm --dir apps/api exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:studio: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --dir apps/api exec prisma studio
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose -p pricelens-dev -f docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose -p pricelens-dev -f docker-compose.yml up -d
